eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Cochise; Santa Cruz; Pima, AZ; at 12:53 AM on AUG 29, 2026 Effective until 8:53 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. A SAFE Alert has been issued for Pima County, Cochise County and Santa Cruz County. The Tucson Police Department is looking for seventy-three-year-old Mary Ellen Arrebollo.  Mary recently displayed memory issues and was last seen on August 28, 2026, at approximately 1:30pm when she was dropped off at a bus stop at East Speedway Boulevard and North Alvernon Way after vacating her residence in the 3700 block of East Bellevue Street. She planned to take a shuttle to her friend's home in Douglas, Arizona, but she did not arrive. Mary is a Hispanic female, approximately 5 feet tall, 125 pounds, with brown eyes, and black curly hair. Mary was last seen wearing a long-sleeved purple shirt, black or gray sweatpants, and black boots. She was carrying a red suitcase with an attached garbage bag, a purse, and a bag. She does not have a working cellular phone with her.

If you have contact with this SAFE Alert, please call 911. If you have contact with this SAFE Alert, please call 911. Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
